description:
The binding gap is not forgetting. It is a wiring failure.

Retest note: this is the Binding Gap cinematic regenerated with the tighter prompt-packet workflow. The opening still did not preserve the exact requested first line, so treat this as a live comparison against the older weak cinematic: sharper description, cleaner claim blocks, and Short-ready mini-sequences around the same idea.

The brief shows why a model can keep the facts while dropping the role, source, and numeric attachments that make the answer usable.
